config.bilibili_media.enable.tip: Enable or disable the Bilibili resolver
config.bilibili_media.enable_cache.tip: Enable Bilibili video caching, disable this option will very likely make the play fail!
config.bilibili_media.enable_yhdm.tip: Enable or disable the YHDM resolver
Enable caching for YHDM resolved videos, may cause display issues.
config.bilibili_media.enable_range_reque: This option is unstable and may cause WaterMedia to fail to display videos
config.bilibili_media.clear_on_start_and: Clear video cache on each start and stop until max cache size
config.bilibili_media.cache_max_size.tip: Maximum cache size, 0 to clear all cache
